records.statement: rJqi has Ripple/Xaman labels and a Ripple-rooted activation chain through rE5Ekd→rLBHK→rHUm, but the downstream intermediaries rP4X2h, rhWt2bh and r4wf7en are unlabelled. Do not claim Ripple beneficial ownership or direct control of every hop.

The repeated rJqi→rP4X2h→rhWt2bh→r4wf7en→Bitso sequence is consistent with an institutional payment or liquidity corridor, but no Ripple Payments/ODL message ID, fiat leg, customer identity, settlement instruction or completed MXN payout is public in the inspected records.
Amounts and timestamps are often close across hops but are not always one-to-one; intermediaries hold other XRP and may aggregate or net flows. Do not claim the same XRP units moved end-to-end.

The Bitso destination is a Bithomp-labelled exchange account with destination tag 88409288. The tag's customer or institutional owner is unknown; a deposit does not prove execution, conversion to MXN or payout completion.

The 90,000,001 and 99,999,999.000005 XRP transfers into rJqi plus the 120M XRP transfer out total about 310M gross movement, but the net change across those three transfers is about +70M XRP to rJqi. A headline calling this 310M of Ripple outflow double-counts the incoming transfers.
